answer_1.quote: We manually annotated 90 randomly selected outputs across models for (1) correctness (overall and step-level) and (2) stylistic similarity ... Most models produced accurate corrections in over 93.3% of cases and maintained stylistic similarity in 87.4%. ... We generate a corrected version of the student's solution ...

answer_2.quote: The results show that corrected solutions from all models yield much higher recall than the corresponding gold solutions for both datasets, indicating superior semantic and stylistic alignment with the student solutions. We also report error step prediction accuracies ...

answer_4.quote: We manually annotated 90 randomly selected outputs across models for (1) correctness ... and (2) stylistic similarity ... Both annotators hold at least a master’s degree ... inter‑annotator agreement is κ = 0.82 for correctness and 0.85 for stylistic similarity.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answered two questions per correction: (1) Is the correction factually and mathematically sound? (Yes/No) and (2) Is the correction stylistically similar to the student's work up to the first error step? (Yes/No).
